title: Minimum SMB Interval cannot go below 3 minutes
symptom: The user can select a time between 1 and 10 minutes as minimum SMB interval, but in LoopPlugin.kt the minimum is hard coded as 3 minutes. When interval is set to 1 minute, an error occurs.
cause: The minimum SMB interval is hard coded as 3 minutes in LoopPlugin.kt, conflicting with the user-selectable range down to 1 minute.
fix: The issue was fixed in version 3.3 via commits 37e9931255662c1abd4d8f4d51f5c9fdd0002eb4 and dcf74d23e8b2fe8de51e416e307e33adcb8d1073.
evidence_quote: The user can select a time between 1 and 10 minutes as minimum SMB interval. Nevertheless in LoopPlugin.kt for instance this minimum is hard coded as 3 minutes.
